name: Turn into eval case appears after Accept and refuses a finding whose review has no agent
description: On PR #482 the first seeded finding ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') is expanded by default and undecided, so it shows no 'Turn into eval case' button. Accepting it reveals the button (spec-0003 AC-1, EC-1 as revised by the user); one click sends the request with the type derived from the decision, and because the seeded review was not produced by an agent the API refuses it and the card shows the reason inline (EC-3). Accept writes to the throwaway hermetic DB only, and this flow runs last; no model is called.
